rules.statement: A purchaser who defaults in payment of the balance of purchase money and subsequently applies to set aside a sale under section 284 of the Civil Procedure Code is not entitled to return of the deposit forfeited under section 262.
rules.supporting_quote: I regret that I do not see that the Court can afford her any relief. Section 284 only allows her to apply to set aside a sale. But by her own default under section 262 the sale seems to me to have been set aside already. There is, consequently, no sale in existence to set aside.

meta.parties: Arunachalam Chetty v. Hamdoon Et Al
